subject: Exception conditions
notes: kb/Work PB75 (2026-08-18) + the EC waves: with checking enabled and an applicable USE declarative naming the condition (or a higher level), the declarative executes; if it completes normally (no RESUME) the run unit terminates abnormally. The declarative runs ONCE per raise — every enclosing statement's guard lets the dispatched condition pass on its way to the boundary (measured: a raise inside PERFORM 2 TIMES ran the declarative twice before this landing).
